sources: rmxlinux Json/SkillData/sk_wpn_claym_0018 passiveEventActions. On the wielder applying a status tagged Immobilization (ability event 102, CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 on tag −1065936627: Si's buff_chr_0036_jsspsi_normal_skill_hitstop; buff_chr_0027_tangtang_ultskill_debuff has the same tag): the target gets buff_wpn_claym_0018_enemyvul (dmg_taken_up, defender-side NormalCalcZone, `duration` 30 s), and the wielder gets buff_wpn_claym_0018_normal_skill_trigger (duration_combo 20 s, max_stack 1). The latter also comes when the wielder casts an ultimate (ability event 30, CheckSkillType [7]). The wielder's next combo cast (ability event 30, [6]) turns it into buff_wpn_claym_0018_normal_skill_comboimbue_atk: + combo_dmg_up × stacks to that cast's hits with decorate mask 8192 (CheckSkillCastId), and the trigger ends. Values: SkillPatchTable sk_wpn_claym_0018 (level 1 → 9: dmg_taken_up 0.075 → 0.21, combo_dmg_up 0.25 → 0.70). Description: "The two effects apply separately and do not stack with themselves."
enemy_vul: ZMDLogs logs it (buff_wpn_claym_0018_enemyvul, vuln_taken 0.18 at skill level 8, 0.21 at 9); Si's ultimate hits in fixtures/zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37.json match exactly with it as DMG taken.

combo_ready: not in logs. Si's 10 combo slashes match exactly with +1.0 DMG bonus in fixtures/zmdlogs-40d9a3c1da37.json (skill level 8: 0.6, plus 2 Type 50 Yinglung stacks of 0.2) and +1.3 in fixtures/zmdlogs-0eef2474a26f.json (level 9: 0.7, plus 3 stacks), both found by hand (see Si's kit).

buffs.label: Jade Vessel: DMG taken after Immobilization
buffs.note: BuffData stackingType 11, max 1, priority key dmg_taken_up: a reapplication by the same wielder replaces it. Two wielders' copies would add up here (batch-1 B9, minor).

buffs.label: Jade Vessel: next combo DMG
buffs.note: max_stack 1, so a plain buff; consumed by the wielder's next combo cast, whose hits it then acts on (buff_wpn_claym_0018_normal_skill_comboimbue_atk).

triggers.note: Ability event 102 (the wielder applies a buff), CheckBuffIdInContext checkType 1 on the Immobilization tag. After the hit's damage: the applying hit itself doesn't get the DMG taken.
